articles.summary: Ciena Corporation (NYSE: CIEN) today announced the appointment of Monika Fahlbusch as Executive Vice President and Chief People Officer, effective today. She will report to President and CEO Gary Smith and lead the company’s global People Culture organization. This press release features multimedia. View the full release here: https://www.businesswire.com/news/home/20261012968337/en/ Ciena Corporation (NYSE: CIEN) today announced the appointment of Monika Fahlbusch as Executive Vice President and Chief People Officer Fahlbusch joins Ciena with more than thirty years of global leadership experience and deep expertise across human resources, including integrating AI, data, and analytics into how organizations shape and execute their people strategies. She has built high-performance teams, led complex transformations, and supported significant business growth.
